title: Double mapping cylinders of realizations model pushouts of spaces
statement:
Use small simplicial sets, geometric realization, spaces and coherent colimits of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], and the category $\mathcal K$ of k-spaces of [lem-coef-realization-finite-limits]. Let $A,B,C$ be small simplicial sets, and let $f:|C|\to|A|$ and $g:|C|\to|B|$ be continuous maps; they need not be realizations of simplicial maps. Form in $\mathcal K$ the double mapping cylinder
$$D(f,g)=\bigl(|A|\amalg(|C|\times[0,1])\amalg|B|\bigr)/\bigl((c,0)\sim f(c),\ (c,1)\sim g(c)\bigr).$$
For any topological space $Z$, its homotopy type means that represented by the singular simplicial set $\operatorname{Sing}(Z)_n=\operatorname{Cont}(|\Delta^n|,Z)$, with operators given by precomposition with the affine simplex maps. The inclusions of $|A|,|B|$ in $D(f,g)$ and the homotopy $c\mapsto[(c,t)]$ form a colimiting cocone in spaces on the span of homotopy types of $|A|\xleftarrow{f}|C|\xrightarrow{g}|B|$. Equivalently, the homotopy pushout of that span is naturally equivalent to the homotopy type of $D(f,g)$, with these specified endpoint maps and connecting homotopy. This is natural for strictly commuting maps of spans of continuous maps. Empty simplicial sets are allowed.

proof.text: Let $W$ be the walking span with objects $a,c,b$ and nonidentity arrows $c\to a$, $c\to b$, and let $V:W\to\mathsf{sSet}$ be the strict diagram $V(a)=\operatorname{Sing}|A|$, $V(c)=\operatorname{Sing}|C|$, $V(b)=\operatorname{Sing}|B|$ with arrows $\operatorname{Sing}(f),\operatorname{Sing}(g)$; this is literally the span of homotopy types in the statement. Work in the Kan model structure of [lem-coef-kan-quillen-right-proper]: its cofibrations are the monomorphisms, so every value of $V$ is cofibrant, and by [lem-coef-simplicial-presheaf-projective-model] it is combinatorial and simplicial for the Cartesian enrichment, with $X\otimes K=X\times K$. Hence [lem-coef-simplicial-bar-projective-resolution] applies with $I=W$: it gives the projectively cofibrant replacement $QV\to V$ (an objectwise weak equivalence) and $\operatorname{colim}_WQV\cong R_W(V)=\int^{[p]}(\coprod_{i_0\to\cdots\to i_p}V(i_0))\times\Delta^p$. By [lem-coef-model-colimit-localization-comparison], after the localization $q$ this ordinary colimit cocone is a coherent colimit cocone of $qV$, and [lem-coef-simplicial-model-nerve-localization] identifies the localization of the Kan model structure with the infinity category $\mathcal S$ of spaces, so this is the colimit in spaces. The legs: the chain $(i)$ with identity final arrow is a section $V(i)\to QV(i)$ of the augmentation, hence its inverse after localization, and its composite to $R_W(V)$ is the inclusion $j_i$ of the summand of the $0$-chain $(i)$; the strict cocone triangles of $QV$ become the $1$-simplices $V(c)\times\Delta^1\to R_W(V)$ given by the summands of the chains $c\to a$ and $c\to b$, whose ends are $j_aV(c\to a)$, $j_bV(c\to b)$ and $j_c$. Finally, elementary (co-Yoneda): in degree $r$ the coend gives $R_W(V)_r=\int^{[p]}(\coprod_{i_0\to\cdots\to i_p}V(i_0)_r)\times\operatorname{Hom}([r],[p])=\coprod_{i_0\to\cdots\to i_r}V(i_0)_r$, with the faces and degeneracies of $\mathrm{BK}_W(V)$ of [lem-coef-bousfield-kan-comparison-calculus]; so $R_W(V)=\mathrm{BK}_W(V)=B_W$ naturally, with $j_i$ the $0$-chain summands.

source.place: Paragraph 2, coherent middle derived adjunction; strict bar/simplicial-replacement computation of the coherent colimit.

proof.text: Let $\Phi:|B_W|\to D(f,g)$ be the weak homotopy equivalence of [lem-coef-singular-span-bar-cylinder-gluing] and define its transpose $\Phi^\flat:B_W\to\operatorname{Sing}D(f,g)$ by $\Phi^\flat(x)=(s\mapsto\Phi[x,s])$; this is continuous in $s$ and commutes with simplicial operators by the realization relations. Directly from the definitions, $\varepsilon_{D}\circ|\Phi^\flat|=\Phi$, where $\varepsilon_D:|\operatorname{Sing}D|\to D$ is the evaluation map. By [lem-coef-singular-counit-weak-equivalence] $\varepsilon_D$ induces bijections on $\pi_0$ and isomorphisms on all $\pi_r$; since $\Phi$ does too, two-out-of-three for isomorphisms (at the basepoints $x$, $|\Phi^\flat|(x)$, $\Phi(x)$) shows that $|\Phi^\flat|$ does, i.e. $\Phi^\flat$ is a weak homotopy equivalence of simplicial sets and $q(B_W)\simeq q\operatorname{Sing}D(f,g)$. Composing the cocone of step 1 with $\Phi^\flat$: for $\sigma\in V(a)_r$ the formula of the cited node gives $\Phi^\flat(j_a\sigma)=\operatorname{incl}_{|A|}\circ\sigma$, so the leg at $a$ is $\operatorname{Sing}$ of the inclusion $|A|\to D(f,g)$; likewise at $b$, and at $c$ it is $\operatorname{Sing}(y\mapsto[(y,1/2)])$. On the chain $c\to a$, a simplex $(\sigma,\theta)$ of $V(c)\times\Delta^1$ goes to $s\mapsto[(\sigma(s),\tfrac12\sum_{\theta(j)=0}s_j)]$, and on $c\to b$ to $s\mapsto[(\sigma(s),1-\tfrac12\sum_{\theta(j)=0}s_j)]$. By the cylinder homeomorphism [lem-coef-simplicial-realization-cylinder] (for $K=\Delta^r$, the coordinate $\sum_{\theta(j)=1}s_j$), these are $\operatorname{Sing}$ of the two halves of the homotopy $(y,t)\mapsto[(y,t)]$ on $|C|\times[0,1]$, and the map $V(c)\times\Delta^2\to\operatorname{Sing}D$, $(\sigma,\theta)\mapsto(s\mapsto[(\sigma(s),\tfrac12\sum_{\theta(j)=1}s_j+\sum_{\theta(j)=2}s_j)])$ is a $2$-simplex in $\operatorname{Fun}(V(c),\operatorname{Sing}D)$ with vertices at positions $0,\tfrac12,1$: its edge $\{1,2\}$ is the $c\to b$ edge, its edge $\{0,1\}$ is the reverse of the $c\to a$ edge (which runs from $j_c$ at position $\tfrac12$ to $j_aV(c\to a)$ at position $0$), and its edge $\{0,2\}$ is $\operatorname{Sing}$ of $c\mapsto[(c,t)]$; all edges are invertible since $\operatorname{Sing}D$ is Kan. Hence the colimit cocone of step 1, transported along the equivalence $\Phi^\flat$, is the cocone of the statement: the two inclusions and the homotopy $c\mapsto[(c,t)]$ from $\operatorname{incl}_{|A|}f$ to $\operatorname{incl}_{|B|}g$. If $C=\varnothing$ then $D=|A|\amalg|B|$ and $B_W=V(a)\amalg V(b)$; if $A$ or $B$ is empty then so is $C$, and the same formulas apply.

source.place: Paragraph 2, explicit realization of the walking-span simplicial replacement and identification with the double mapping cylinder.

proof.text: For a strictly commuting map of spans $(\alpha_A,\alpha_C,\alpha_B)$, applying $\operatorname{Sing}$ gives a strict map of $W$-diagrams $V\to V'$. The projective bar replacement, the isomorphism $\operatorname{colim}QV\cong R_W(V)$, the formula $R_W(V)=\mathrm{BK}_W(V)$ and the localized colimit cocone are functorial in maps of $W$-diagrams by the cited statements. The map $\Phi$ is natural by [lem-coef-singular-span-bar-cylinder-gluing], so $\Phi^\flat$ is natural (its definition is pointwise); the counit is natural by [lem-coef-singular-counit-weak-equivalence]. Since $\alpha_A\amalg(\alpha_C\times1)\amalg\alpha_B$ commutes with both inclusions and with $c\mapsto[(c,t)]$, the equivalence of step 2 and all specified cocone data are natural in the span.

The item statement is true and unchanged: I checked it on C empty, A or B empty (which forces C empty), the point/interval case and the suspension case. Three repairable faults, all fixed under fixes/dag/nodes/sec-six-functors/. (1) C1/E1, step 1: it applied the bar-resolution node and the model-colimit node to sSet without citing that the Kan model structure is a combinatorial simplicial model category, and without identifying its localization with spaces. Step 1 now cites lem-coef-kan-quillen-right-proper, lem-coef-simplicial-presheaf-projective-model and lem-coef-simplicial-model-nerve-localization. It also names the cocone legs explicitly and writes out R_W(V)=BK_W(V) as an elementary co-Yoneda step. (2) C1/E5, step 2: it went from the topological weak equivalence |R_W(V)|->D(f,g) to the homotopy type Sing D(f,g) without the counit theorem. D is not a realization, so the cited unit theorem does not give this, and neither the DAG nor Mathlib has the counit theorem (SingularSet.lean only defines sSetTopAdj). I added the statement-only node lem-coef-singular-counit-weak-equivalence; its archived source is WANTED. Step 2 now builds the transpose Phi^flat, checks eps_D∘|Phi^flat|=Phi, applies two-out-of-three, and identifies the legs as Sing of the two inclusions. It also builds a 2-simplex showing that Sing of c->[(c,t)] is the composite of the two chain edges. Step 2 no longer uses the off-route lem-cbc-realization-singular-unit-weak, so no tool_uses are needed and all proof_deps are in sk-prop-sf-biduality-general. (3) B2/E5: the new node lem-coef-singular-span-bar-cylinder-gluing left the map on its two interval chains unspecified. It now gives Phi by an explicit formula on BK_W(V) (positions w/2, 1-w/2 and 1/2). I checked the formula against faces and degeneracies. It is true by the counit maps eps_{|X|} and the gluing lemma, it is not a restatement of the item, and it duplicates no existing node (rg and blueprint_refs searches). After the fixes, every cited id exists, proof_deps equals the union of the step uses, and there is no cycle. No SGA is cited.
